# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.15.0

## What's new

- **Your game's language:** the price check, market and screen reading now work when the game runs in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean or Traditional Chinese. Items are read and shown the way your game writes them, and listings come back in that language. Skills panel gems and Expedition rewards are read off the screen in your game's language too. (Traditional Chinese listings stay in English: pathofexile.tw is a separate realm.)
- **Automatic league:** a new Automatic option (the default) follows the current league, so on launch day your filter, price check and market move to the new league by themselves. Click the league name at the top of the panel to switch.
- **Loot filter safety check:** if a game patch removes an item or item class a rule names, that rule is left out and the app tells you, so the game still loads your filter.
- **Theoretical Craft:** modifiers whose weight no source knows (desecrated) are marked, and the list says where the weights come from. A saved craft keeps a modifier the game no longer has, marked (!).
- **Discord:** the main panel links to the community server.

## Fixes

- **Price check:** a modifier that is both fractured and crafted is read correctly.
- **Theoretical Craft:** ES Recharge on hybrid body armours rolls at its corrected weight.

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
